label: SMEE cumulative lithography tools of any type, company-counted delivery milestone
definition: SMEE's own cumulative count of lithography/exposure tools of any type (front-end scanners, pre-2025 advanced-packaging steppers, LED/compound-semiconductor and flat-panel-display exposure tools) delivered to customers, as the company itself counts its own round-number delivery milestones (e.g. 'the 100th tool'); not separable into lithography_frontend or lithography_packaging, and not attributable to a single product family.
